blocks.text:
The CSS
grid-template-areas is a
grid container property, and it specifies
areas within the grid layout.

You can name grid items by using the CSS grid-area
property, and then reference to the name in the grid-template-areas
property.
Each area is defined within apostrophes. The named grid items in each area is defined inside the apostrophes, separated by a space.
